summary_md: **Tech Lead Corner ([@techleadcorner](https://x.com/techleadcorner/status/2116667604819677198))** shares **Coucou**, an MIT companion app that shows what coding agents are doing from the MacBook notch (and iPhone) and lets you approve requests without switching windows ([Louis-CFM/coucou](https://github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Louis-CFM/coucou: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.

relevance: Ambient approval UI for coding agents.

media.description: Demo of Coucou showing agent status in the MacBook notch.
